recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Moonroom Life Simulator** as a single-page browser game using plain HTML, CSS, Canvas, and vanilla JavaScript. Preserve the source life-simulator mechanics exactly: a start/loading flow, touch joystick and keyboard movement in a large 2400x2400 world, camera follow, open-ended traversal, role selection, emotes, chat, faster vehicle toggle, wandering/chatting bots, and proximity-based claiming of unowned homes with no added win/loss/score semantics.

Transform the presentation into a satirical soft-girl magical life simulator with Sailor-Moon-inspired celestial energy without copying protected characters. The player is a Moonroom main character. Homes are Dream Dorms. Roles are Life Arcs. Emotes are Tiny Rituals. Chat is the Slay Feed. The vehicle is a Sparkle Scooter. Use pixel-art/rainbowcore/soft pastel visual language, procedural stars, crescent motifs, dorm shrines, cozy stress-relief copy, and meme-tone cues such as "slay" and "it's giving". Keep the experience portrait-first and one-thumb friendly for mobile.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) is a browser-native canvas roleplay/life-simulator playground. The player enters through a start/loading flow, moves in a 2400x2400 world with a touch joystick or keyboard, sees bot residents wander/chat/claim houses, can claim an unowned house when within the original proximity radius, can toggle a faster vehicle, choose a role, perform emotes, and send chat. There is no win/loss terminal state and no numeric score; progress is social ownership/customization/roleplay state.

## Protected mechanics
- One-thumb joystick movement and keyboard fallback.
- World size, camera follow, player bounds, walk/vehicle speed semantics.
- Bot count and bot wander/chat/emote/claim behavior.
- House/dorm claim proximity and one-owner rule.
- Open-ended play without new fail/win rules.
- Modal, chat, role, emote, vehicle, and start-flow actionability.

## Remixed target
Moonroom Life Simulator reframes the same loop as a satirical soft-girl magical life simulator inspired by celestial transformation-team anime energy. The player is a Moonroom main character navigating cozy life arcs, claiming a Dream Dorm, posting to the Slay Feed, using Tiny Rituals, and riding a Sparkle Scooter through a rainbowcore pixel-celestial neighborhood.

## Implementation spine
A single rebuilt public `index.html` uses inline CSS, Canvas, and vanilla JavaScript. It preserves the mechanic-facing structure while replacing old cyber/city presentation with procedural stars, pastel moon roads, dorm shrine houses, magical-girl silhouettes, soft HUD panels, and meme-tone copy.
